author: Insta360
description:
Learn how to create cinematic videos using just your phone and a compact smartphone gimbal. This Insta360 Flow 2 Pro tutorial covers essential camera settings and practical gimbal shots—no big camera gear needed.

Created in collaboration with @Learn Online Video, discover how a pocket-sized phone gimbal delivers professional results with precise control and stable motion. From reveal and orbit shots to parallax, crane, and wide-angle movements, see how to elevate everyday shooting into high-quality cinematic footage. This minimal-gear workflow is perfect for mobile creators who want pro-looking video while staying light and agile.
